'''XL-5''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|war droid]] that was used by a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] crew to protect their operations during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. XL-5 was armed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and a [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].
